question.text: Before we scope the build, the most load-bearing decision is what we actually stand up first. This repo is empty, so the very first mission isn't the Mint clone — it's the FOUNDATION: a booting skeleton, a real test runner a human can watch run, and one thin slice proving they're wired together. Every feature you named (Plaid sync, budgets, charts, mobile app, CSV import, recurring-bill detection, multi-currency, household mode) gets recorded in the vision doc and filed as its own mission right after. For the foundation stack, I'd recommend **Vite + React + TypeScript + Vitest** — it boots a web UI fast, Vitest gives you a watchable test run, and it's a natural base for the budgets-and-charts personal-finance app you're describing. Does a TypeScript web app sound right, or were you picturing something else (e.g. mobile-first native, or a Python/backend-first build)?
